sources.source_name: Breakwave Dry Bulk Shipping ETF (NYSE: BDRY) via Yahoo Finance
sources.license_or_access_notes: Public exchange traded asset. Personal and academic research use.

Synthesized from BDRY market movements, USDA bunker prices, and standard nautical distances. NOT observed commercial spot fixture contracts.
